_note: The Scud truck (GLOSSARY: Scud truck, Launcher, Lock point, Scud missile, Scud blast). Parsed by ScudFile (ShooterCore/Scud/ScudData.cs); every field is checked at load. launcher: the timings of the launcher machine and the targeting rules. targeting: the operator's bird's-eye screen. missile: the planned flight (a vertical boost, then one arc down onto the point) and who is warned. blast: the impact (metres, hit points, seconds). The numbers are a first guess and want a feel pass.
